description: Hash-bound findings from a manual non-Golden 100-pair audit; source holds cannot be auto-cleared, target holds require source-proven corrections. No samples are selected using Golden scores.

findings.subject: New York health-plan costs
findings.reason: Source and target have an internal arithmetic contradiction: stated formula gives Plan A 4800+1000+240=6040, not 7040. Savings versus Plan B should be 440, not 1440; 'most expensive' conclusion also needs revision. Correct paired source/target consistently under the explicitly stated formula, or regenerate if procedure-cost assumptions differ.

findings.subject: Family keto menu
findings.reason: Seven-day meals, prep times and grocery quantities retained, but menu Table declares image and imageAlt columns absent from every state row and unsupported by source. Remove these unused columns using a schema-aware pipeline repair; no images should be invented.

findings.subject: Student sedan comparison
findings.reason: Facts/actions retained, but table label 'Avg MPG (Combined)' becomes 'Avg MPG', removing the stated combined-driving basis. Restore the full source column label (and Maintenance Cost) without changing values.

findings.subject: Brake diagnosis and toolkit
findings.reason: Five diagnostic rows, eight tools and cost table intact, but source paragraphs at lines 7, 19, 32 omitted. In particular, budget assumptions 'mid-range ceramic pads and vented rotors for a 2018 Civic' disappear. Restore these source-proven context sentences via the generation/preparation pipeline.

findings.subject: November watering alerts
findings.reason: Monstera 2024-11-29 is stored in alert_5 but no Table column displays it. Source header itself lacks Date 5. Also 14-day Succulent series stops at Nov15 although Nov29 is within the stated period. Repair header/column binding; correct the simple source/target recurrence together after confirming inclusive November scope.

findings.subject: Switch RPG list
findings.reason: Source promises a Chrono Trigger Switch/eShop product, but retained URL points to an unverified chrono-trigger-switch page and official Square Enix material found lists other platforms. Quarantine for source verification/regeneration; changing only the button would not fix the platform-specific recommendation.

findings.subject: The Hobbit reading status
findings.reason: Source's Chapter 14 summary is materially wrong: publisher guide has Smaug attacking Lake-town and Bard slaying him, not Bilbo arriving there or mediating. Requires replacement source summary and regeneration, not a mechanical IR edit.

findings.subject: New York retail lease
findings.reason: SBA Business Guide [SOURCE_URL_1] citation is omitted. Both source/target also mask ordinary phrase asset/liability as [MEDIA_ASSET_1]; retained URL map proves this was not an asset. Tighten normalization to preserve prose and restore the source-proven citation.

findings.subject: Berlin pet-focused cleaning
findings.reason: Drops source qualification that a normal professional 3-bedroom deep clean typically exceeds EUR200, and omits two-shedding-dogs context. Ten tasks and all links remain. Restore source paragraphs rather than leaving the budget sounding sufficient for a full service.

findings.subject: TechCorp stock-growth tutorial
findings.reason: P/E and P/S option names lose '(Price-to-Earnings)' and '(Price-to-Sales)' expansions, specifically useful in this beginner explanation. Restore source labels; numerical growth/formula and other content intact.

findings.subject: Data deletion rights
findings.reason: Target faithfully repeats source legal guidance, but GDPR is stated as a fixed 30-day deadline (twice) and downstream erasure notification is unconditional. EDPB specifies one month, conditional extension and recipient-notification exceptions. Quarantine this legal checklist for qualified source review, including its CCPA comparisons, then regenerate the target; do not silently patch the target alone.

findings.subject: Fixed versus tracker mortgage
findings.reason: Risk section drops fixed-term examples (2/5/10 years), tracker base-rate-plus-margin explanation and payment-shock/disposable-income definition. Restore complete source risk paragraphs; tables, options, amounts and links otherwise match.

findings.subject: London jazz venues
findings.reason: The London concert recommendation names Blue Note and sends Book Tickets to https://www.bluenote.com, the Blue Note Records record-label site, not evidence for the stated London event. Dates, distance and booking recommendation cannot be validated from the available original-query-less record. Quarantine for venue/event provenance correction; do not invent a replacement venue or URL.

findings.subject: HYSA versus CD liquidity
findings.reason: Source/target label rates APY but divide them by 12 as nominal rates; six-month earnings are inconsistent with that label. If quoted APYs are authoritative, use 10000*((1+APY)^0.5-1), yielding 207.84 and 246.95. Correct formula/labels/earnings together after rate-basis verification, not just target numbers.

findings.subject: Greek salad instructions
findings.reason: Table has unsupported image/imageAlt columns with no row values. Also drops ripe/seasonal produce/high-quality-feta instruction and 'rustic rather than uniform' slicing goal. All ingredients and five assembly steps remain. Source-grounded repair can restore context and prune unused columns.

findings.subject: Raspberry Pi SSH setup
findings.reason: Step 4 compression drops explicit Wi-Fi SSID/password and first-boot network instruction, plus SSH credential rationale. Restore complete source step; other steps/checklist/actions intact.

findings.subject: Zigbee interference guide
findings.reason: Compression drops distinction that battery-powered end devices do not repeat, receiver-saturation explanation and beyond-a-few-feet symptom. Restore source technical paragraphs rather than teaching shortened incomplete guidance.

findings.subject: Weekly sleep analysis
findings.reason: Total-sleep variable label is mojibake '╬ú Hours' instead of sum/Sigma Hours. Source formula proves intended symbol, making a localized encoding repair possible; all seven-day data and mean arithmetic correct.

findings.subject: Quarterly regional sales
findings.reason: Source/target annual total says 17100 but 5600+4700+6200=16500 (also sum of quarterly totals). Requested line chart with Q4 peak highlight is absent; target substitutes a Table only. Correct paired total and regenerate a Chart bound to supplied data.

findings.subject: Junior engineer onboarding
findings.reason: Compresses all three milestone sections, omitting runtime/cloud examples, launch-application verification, API-to-database walkthrough scope, addressing PR feedback and staging path. Restore the source-proven instructions; roadmap/actions already intact.

findings.subject: Playlist queue controls
findings.reason: Three source per-track removal URLs survive only in state.queue[*].actionUrl. The explicit Table columns omit that field; only the cross symbol actionLabel is projected, and the playlist renderer consumes projected columns. Restore three correctly bound source-URL actions through the generation pipeline; do not invent queue mutation semantics. Shuffle/Clear buttons are already preserved.

findings.subject: Freelance design contract
findings.reason: Clause compression drops before-work retainer timing, remaining-50-percent payments, 7-day grace example, social-media right, consolidated-feedback definition and per-revision alternative. NYC source reference is also bound to ACTION_URL_1 instead of supplied SOURCE_URL_2. Restore full source clauses and exact citation binding; legal appropriateness remains separate.

findings.subject: Static versus dynamic QR
findings.reason: Source and target claim static QR codes have no tracking capabilities and dynamic codes are the only viable tracking option. Official Google Analytics guidance supports campaign-tagged destination URLs; a fixed/static QR can encode such a URL (inference), so the absolute premise is unsound. Scan visits also do not by themselves establish an exact count of people. Quarantine for substantive source rewrite and target regeneration.

findings.subject: Raised-bed soil volume
findings.reason: Source/target introductory 3.7 cubic yards contradicts 12*10*1/27=4.44 and existing table. Correct paired intro to 4.44; all planting data/actions are otherwise preserved.

findings.subject: London workshop plan
findings.reason: Budget sums correctly, but requirements lose 'at least' in 20-percent dietary provision, cabaret/classroom layouts, wrap-lunch alternative and 'simultaneous' in 50 Wi-Fi connections. Restore exact source requirements; roadmap/actions intact.

findings.subject: QR recruiter capture form
findings.reason: The source describes a recruiter-interface design; the target turns descriptive phrases into actual field values ('Auto-filled from QR', 'Optional short-text field') and invents a preselected 3/5 rating. Preserve the design as descriptive content, or use clearly unpopulated controls under an explicit contract; do not invent a candidate, QR payload or backend binding. This is source-grounded target repair, not a reason to require or fabricate backend data.

findings.subject: JFK-LHR flight comparison
findings.reason: The same JFK-to-LHR comparison gives departure/arrival/duration combinations implying UTC offsets of 5, 8 and 7 hours when arrivals are next day. No dates/timezones clarify the discrepancy; a stop does not reconcile total elapsed duration. Economic totals are correct ($1,150 each), but actual schedules cannot be reconstructed safely. Quarantine until verified departure, arrival and duration data are supplied.

findings.subject: Portfolio profit
findings.reason: Two tables use statePath /portfolio/variables and /portfolio/assets, but root state stores these as literal slash-containing keys instead of nested portfolio data. The checked Android JSON-pointer resolver traverses nested keys, so neither table resolves. Canonicalize the state/path relationship through a tested pipeline fix; all portfolio values and 4.29% return are otherwise consistent.

findings.subject: Seattle hybrid SUV affordability
findings.reason: Source/target claim a choice fits a strict 450/month loan-plus-insurance budget while its loan estimate alone is 440-480, with no insurance quote, down payment, term or APR. Recommendation is not supported by supplied numbers; quarantine until source assumptions are verified and regenerated.

findings.subject: Mumbai monsoon explainer
findings.reason: National Geographic citation is downgraded to a bare label with no SOURCE_URL_1, and Britannica label/SOURCE_URL_2 disappear completely. Restore both source-bound citations; scientific paragraphs and wind rows otherwise retained.

findings.subject: Daily deep-work timeline
findings.reason: Eight timeline entries retain their seven distinct source icons only in state-row icon fields. Table projects only time/activity/details and has no entityMedia mapping or explicit icon nodes. Bind the existing source icons visibly through a supported generated layout; all times, activity text and analysis rows are preserved.

findings.subject: Hydration calculation
findings.reason: The source and target claim 120-150 oz, although their own stated components are 90 + 30 + (10-30) = 130-150 oz; the liters summary must also agree if the formula is retained. Both tables additionally use /hydration_variables and /fluid_breakdown against literal slash-prefixed state keys, which the checked Android JSON-pointer lookup cannot resolve. Repair paired numerical consistency and state bindings, with source medical review before treating the hydration guidance as authoritative.

findings.subject: Graphic designer to UX
findings.reason: Target drops NN/g higher-cost/intensity caveat, before/after-shift boundary, company-landing-page example and contrast against 10 superficial screens. Restore complete source guidance; six-month roadmap intact.

findings.subject: Paris pool hotels
findings.reason: Values and pool/budget filtering correct, but 'Rating-to-Price Ratio' becomes unexplained 'Ratio'. Restore full metric label so the derived numbers have their intended meaning.

findings.subject: Backpacker insurance priorities
findings.reason: First comparison-column header is 'Medical Evacuation' even though it holds multiple coverage types (evacuation/theft/cancellation). This source error is reproduced in target; relabel paired header to Coverage/Coverage Type. All priority prose and links retained.

findings.subject: Aggressive portfolio review
findings.reason: Target drops the definition of uncompensated risk and the value/dividend-versus-capital-growth explanation underpinning the allocation recommendation. Restore complete source reasoning; allocations/options/actions retained.

findings.subject: Tokyo allergy translation
findings.reason: The English severe-allergy phrases say 'shellfish', while the Japanese/romaji specify only crustaceans (甲殻類 / koukaku-rui). A Japanese Consumer Affairs Agency report distinguishes crustaceans from molluscan shellfish, so the claimed translation narrows the allergy scope. Quarantine both source and target for qualified allergy-translation validation and regeneration; do not use the card as safety guidance.

findings.reason: Compressed cards omit Dell storage-versus-ASUS and premium-price explanation, Mac display benefit and 'not recommended unless upgraded' condition; ASUS comparison scope also shortened. Restore full source option descriptions rather than training these omissions.
